feed_summary: Threat actors are attempting to exploit an unpatched maximum-severity security vulnerability in the CryptoPayment Gateway WordPress plugin, according to findings from Defused Cyber. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-81648, which carries a CVSS score of 10.0. title: Attackers Target Unpatched CryptoPayment Gateway Flaw That Can Expose Wallet Credentials
